description: Returns every distinct code catalogued under a given code_type, paginated, with each code's raw chargemaster description and the number of hospitals reporting it. Use this to discover which codes exist under a code system (e.g. all CPT codes) before looking up prices with get_hospital_chargemaster_cost or list_hospital_code_costs. Pass query to text-search codes/descriptions instead of listing a whole code_type. Pass hospital_id to restrict results to codes that one hospital actually reports.

code_type.description: Code system to list codes for, e.g. "CPT". From list_code_types. May be left empty when query is set, to search across code types (excluding hospital-specific CDM and LOCAL codes) - CodeSummary.code_type tells the hits apart in that case.

hospital_id.description: Optional hospital scoping (a hospital_id from list_hospitals): restricts results to codes that hospital actually reports on its latest revision, and makes sample_count_min/max/exact that hospital's own sample size for the code rather than the network-wide total. Unset (default) is network-wide. page_token is only valid with the same hospital_id it was issued for, same as query/code_type/sort.

min_class_hospital_count.description: Minimum hospitals behind a billing class's median for the class orders (facility/professional median price: that class; facility share: both classes). A code below it sorts last but is still listed. Without it a code one hospital files can top the share lists. Ignored by other sorts and with hospital_id; negative is INVALID_ARGUMENT.

page_size.description: Maximum number of results to return. Defaults to 500, capped at 500.

page_token.description: Opaque token from a previous list_codes response. Omit for the first page. Only valid with the same query/code_type/sort it was issued for.

query.description: Case-insensitive text search: matches the code as a prefix, and substrings of the raw and AI-generated descriptions. Descriptions are only searched for queries of 4+ characters; shorter queries match the code prefix only. When set, code_type may be left empty to search across code types.

sort.description: Ordering for the returned codes. CODE_SORT_UNSPECIFIED (default) sorts code-alphabetical. CODE_SORT_HOSPITAL_COUNT_DESC sorts most-hospitals-reporting first, for pre-sorted 'top codes' pages. CODE_SORT_SAMPLE_COUNT_DESC sorts by largest network-wide pricing sample size first (sample_count_max, always network-wide regardless of hospital_id) - ranks by how many billing records actually back a code's pricing, rather than by how many hospitals merely report it. CODE_SORT_CODE_DESC is code-alphabetical, reverse order. CODE_SORT_RELEVANCE ranks best text match first (exact code, then code prefix, then description word-start, then description substring), ties broken by network-wide sample count descending, and is only meaningful - and the default - when query is set; without a query it behaves like CODE_SORT_SAMPLE_COUNT_DESC. CODE_SORT_HOSPITAL_COUNT_ASC / CODE_SORT_SAMPLE_COUNT_ASC surface rare codes (fewest hospitals / smallest network-wide sample first; zero counts sort last). CODE_SORT_MEDIAN_PRICE_DESC/ASC order by the network-wide median price (CodeSummary.median_price) and CODE_SORT_PRICE_SPREAD_DESC by the widest hospital-to-hospital spread (price_spread); codes with no price sort last in every price order. Price figures are network-wide even when hospital_id is set, and blend billing classes, methodologies and settings. Billing-class orders (upstream #2144, list_codes only): CODE_SORT_FACILITY_MEDIAN_PRICE_DESC/ASC and CODE_SORT_PROFESSIONAL_MEDIAN_PRICE_DESC/ASC rank by that class's median price; CODE_SORT_FACILITY_SHARE_DESC (mostly-facility codes first) / _ASC (mostly-professional first) rank by facility_share. Codes lacking the figure, or with fewer hospitals than min_class_hospital_count, sort last.

name: list_codes

ai_description.description: LLM-normalized, human-readable description. Empty when not yet backfilled - fall back to raw_description.

code_type.description: This code's type, e.g. "CPT". Always set - distinguishes hits when query was searched across code types (code_type left empty in the request).

facility_median_price.description: Network-wide median over hospitals of each hospital's average price under the facility billing class (unlike median_price, not blended). Unset when no hospital files the class. Network-wide even when hospital_id is set.

facility_share.description: facility_median_price / (facility + professional median) as a percent with 2 decimals; the professional share is 100 minus it. Unset unless both medians are.

hospital_count.description: Distinct hospitals reporting this code (latest revision only).

median_price.description: Network-wide price: the median of the hospitals' average prices for this code, taken over all billing classes, methodologies and settings (so facility and professional fees are blended). Unset when no hospital has a positive average price. Always network-wide, even when hospital_id is set.

price_spread.description: p90 / p10 of the hospitals' average prices for this code. Unset when median_price is.

priced_at.description: When the snapshot the price figures come from was published (protobuf Timestamp: seconds, nanos); recomputed with each snapshot.

priced_hospital_count.description: Hospitals with a positive average price behind median_price and price_spread.

professional_median_price.description: As facility_median_price, for the professional billing class.

raw_description.description: Raw chargemaster text, picked across reporting hospitals. Not necessarily a human-readable procedure name.

sample_count_exact.description: True iff sample_count_min == sample_count_max, i.e. no contributing row was a de-identified '1 through 10' range.

sample_count_max.description: Upper bound on the CMS sample-remittance count, as a decimal string (int64 - see protoLoaderOptions.longs), same network-wide-vs-hospital-scoped convention as sample_count_min. Equal to sample_count_min unless a de-identified '1 through 10' row narrowed it to a range.

sample_count_min.description: Lower bound on the CMS sample-remittance count, as a decimal string (int64 - see protoLoaderOptions.longs). By default (no hospital_id in the request) this sums every reporting hospital's contributing payer rows, network-wide; when the request scopes to a hospital_id, it's that one hospital's own sample count for this code instead. Equal to sample_count_max unless a de-identified '1 through 10' row narrowed it to a range.

next_page_token.description: Opaque pagination token, empty when there are no more results.

total_count.description: Total number of matching codes across all pages.

title: List billing codes for a code type
